thread:
Mira (marketing lead): Hey team — draft one-pager for enterprise launch is in the doc I just dropped. Need alignment on primary angle (security-first vs SLA/economics), short benchmark callouts, webinar CTA, and inbound routing rules for field. Looking for final approvals by EOD today.
Ajay (product marketing): My vote: security-first headline for regulated buyers, with a compact ops box that highlights SLA and cost benefits. Two one-pager variants: CISO (security + compliance) and SRE/Platform (SLOs + cost).
Priya (solutions eng): Benchmarks I can vouch for from the lab: p50 ~45ms, p95 ~120ms on Dedicated (8x A100 equivalent). Prefix caching reduces token cost ~30% for chat workloads. I'll add an ops micro-chart and link to the test harness.
Sean (sales): For routing - we need explicit lead-score rules. High priority if ARR >= $100k OR tag=gov/healthcare. Route those to AE-enterprise and CC SE-security. Everyone else to inbound SDR. Also want a webinar registration path that creates MQLs flagged as 'enterprise-webinar'.
Kim (designer): I can mock both pockets (CISO + SRE). Need a hero line by noon. Suggestions: "Predictable enterprise inference — secure, scalable, cost-transparent." Keep subhead under 10 words.
Legal-bot: Flag: language "guarantee" on line 8. Replace with "SLA-backed where applicable" or add explicit caveat. Also redact specific uptime percentages for hosted unless coordinated with Product.
Mira (marketing lead): Good catch @Legal-bot. Priya, can you replace guarantee language and add the short legal caveat? Ajay — please pick the hero and micro-messaging for both variants.
Priya (solutions eng): Done — updated doc and swapped wording to: "SLA-backed for Dedicated; hosted terms subject to published SLA." Added a concise webhook-friendly curl sample for the benchmark page.
Priya (solutions eng): curl sample: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/benchmarks -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"model":"rwd-2b","seq_len":512,"batch":8}'```
Sean (sales): Routing snippet for HubSpot (pseudo):
```yaml
- conditions:
    - annual_revenue >= 100000
    - industry in ["financial_services","healthcare"]
  assign: "AE-enterprise"
  cc: "SE-security"
- conditions:
    - tag == "regulated"
  assign: "SE-security"
- default:
  assign: "Inbound-SDR"
  nurture_campaign: "launch-webinar-mql"
```
Kim (designer): For layout: left column hero + 3 benefit bullets (Security / Predictable Cost / Deployment Flexibility), right column micro-benchmark box and CTA buttons: "Get a demo" and "Register for webinar". I can produce mobile + print variants.
Ajay (product marketing): For hero lines — CISO: "Protect inference, preserve privacy, control deployment." SRE: "Predictable latency. Measurable cost. Flexible modes." Pick one per variant.
Mira (marketing lead): Love those. We'll publish two variants to the field: "CISO pack" and "Platform ops pack". Webinar blurb to use as CTA: "Join our launch webinar: Comparing Deploy Modes — private, dedicated, hosted. Live demo + Q&A." Link will tag registrants as enterprise-webinar.
Legal-bot: Approved language with caveat added. Removed any absolute "guarantee" words. Confirmed we can say "SLA-backed" only for Dedicated and Private.
Priya (solutions eng): I also added a short troubleshooting note for field: "If a prospect requests GovCloud, route to Partner Ops (gov) + SE-security." Added to the routing YAML as a rule.
Mira (marketing lead): Final checklist: Sales approval (Sean) — please confirm routing rules by 5pm PT. Legal — thanks for the quick review. Design — expect final assets by 3pm. Webinar ops — can you confirm landing page + registration mapping by tomorrow 12pm? :thumbsup:
Sean (sales): Confirmed on routing rules. Small ask — add an auto-alert to #sales when a lead with ARR >=100k registers. I put a note in the doc.
Kim (designer): I'll upload final PNGs and a 1-page print PDF into the doc by 2:30pm.
Mira (marketing lead): Great — once assets are in, I'll queue the field email and social blurbs. Thanks team — moving to final stage.
